column1: # Uniform-register / predicate / return-PC scheduling hazards -- the resources
# the per-class dependency-rule model (dependency_rules_<sm>.tsv) does not name.
# Recovered from CUDA-13.1 ptxas + nvdisasm static analysis and VERIFIED on an
# sm_89 GPU (RTX Ada, compute_cap 8.9): each producer->consumer pair is compiled
# with `ptxas -arch sm_89`, its emitted SASS control word decoded
# (decoded/sass-tools/sass_launch.py, 5 seeds), then the hazard distance is
# patch-swept down to the minimum that still reproduces the bit-identical
# read-back (gpu_min).  RPC + UPRED.bindless rows that sm_89 ptxas does not emit
# are STATIC (ptxas/nvdisasm analysis); their gpu_min column reads "-".
#   RPC   return-PC / USETMAXREG implicit ordering (branch ops, USETMAXREG)
#   producer        SASS opcode (class) that writes the resource
#   consumer        SASS opcode (class) that reads it
#   kind            RAW | WAW | WAR | RPC-ORDER ; +coupled/decoupled where it
#                   matters (coupled = fixed usched stall on the producer;
#                   decoupled = producer arms a write scoreboard, consumer waits)
#   source_model    producer->consumer latency from the ptxas scheduling model
#   ptxas_emitted   the stall/scoreboard ptxas actually put on sm_89 (cyc, or
#   gpu_min         min cycles that still reproduce V1 on the sm_89 GPU
#                   ("SB"=hardware async barrier, not a sweepable stall; "-"=static)

coupled uniform-datapath producer; not-bindless latency band 6 (sm_89 emits producer stall 4, GPU-tight at 4)

ULDC.64 base ptr -> STG address operand; bindless band 5 / not-bindless residual, GPU-tight at 1 for the address path

branch/return-PC writers order against following math at distance 9 (the implicit return-PC hazard); sm_89 exposes it as CALL.REL.NOINC / RET.REL.NODEC sequencing, not a sweepable scoreboard (static)
